finding: The first three consecutive generated samples use only color-3 markers, so the color-specific rival exactly matches every visible output. The fourth uses color 4; the rival incorrectly extends nine red cells through the blocked lanes.
limits: One source-bound seed and one executable rival; this establishes a concrete ambiguity, not a complete audit of the optional peer. No source edit was made.

rival.mechanism: Treat only color-3 markers as blockers instead of every nonzero non-red marker.
rival.name: only literal color 3 blocks rays
rival.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((red-cells (find-color g 2))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells red-cells))
         (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb)) (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
         (greens (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (fst p) (snd p)))) (= v 3))) (grid-positions g)))
         (above-cols (map snd (filter (lambda (p) (and (< (fst p) r1) (>= (snd p) c1) (<= (snd p) c2))) greens)))
         (below-cols (map snd (filter (lambda (p) (and (> (fst p) r2) (>= (snd p) c1) (<= (snd p) c2))) greens)))
         (left-rows (map fst (filter (lambda (p) (and (< (snd p) c1) (>= (fst p) r1) (<= (fst p) r2))) greens)))
         (right-rows (map fst (filter (lambda (p) (and (> (snd p) c2) (>= (fst p) r1) (<= (fst p) r2))) greens)))
         (up-cols (filter (lambda (c) (not (member c above-cols))) (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
         (down-cols (filter (lambda (c) (not (member c below-cols))) (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
         (left-rows2 (filter (lambda (r) (not (member r left-rows))) (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
         (right-rows2 (filter (lambda (r) (not (member r right-rows))) (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
         (g2 (reduce (lambda (gg c) (reduce (lambda (gg2 r) (if (zero? (at gg2 r c)) (set-cell gg2 r c 2) gg2)) gg (range 0 r1))) g up-cols))
         (g3 (reduce (lambda (gg c) (reduce (lambda (gg2 r) (if (zero? (at gg2 r c)) (set-cell gg2 r c 2) gg2)) gg (range (+ r2 1) h))) g2 down-cols))
         (g4 (reduce (lambda (gg r) (reduce (lambda (gg2 c) (if (zero? (at gg2 r c)) (set-cell gg2 r c 2) gg2)) gg (range 0 c1))) g3 left-rows2)))
    (reduce (lambda (gg r) (reduce (lambda (gg2 c) (if (zero? (at gg2 r c)) (set-cell gg2 r c 2) gg2)) gg (range (+ c2 1) w))) g4 right-rows2))))
